UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Authenticated ReelPulse user account profile stored securely under the owner's UID. Clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: User's full name or display username.

email.description: Authenticated email address from Firebase Auth.

accountVisibility.description: Account privacy mode chosen by the user: personal (private) or public.

VideoMetadata.title: VideoMetadata
VideoMetadata.description: Metadata for a short video recorded in-app or selected from the device gallery and posted by the signed-in user. Clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator who posted the video.

title.description: Short title for the posted video.

category.description: Content category used by the For You recommendation engine.

tags.description: Up to 10 hashtags associated with the video.

videoUri.description: Local file URI, gallery content URI, or sample stream URI of the video.

filterId.description: Identifier of the camera/video filter preset applied to the clip.

filterName.description: Human-readable name of the applied camera filter.

sourceType.description: How the video was captured or selected.

creatorName.description: Creator display name at post time.

BlockedUser.title: BlockedUser
BlockedUser.description: Blocked creator record stored under the blocking user's UID so blocked creators' content is hidden from their feed. Clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who initiated the block.

blockedCreatorId.description: Identifier of the blocked creator or user.

blockedCreatorName.description: Display name of the blocked creator at block time.

blockedCreatorAvatarKey.description: Avatar key for rendering the blocked user in management lists.

createdAt.description: Server-assigned timestamp when the user was blocked (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

LiveStreamSession.title: LiveStreamSession
LiveStreamSession.description: Real-time live broadcast session hosted by an authenticated ReelPulse creator. Clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for startedAt, updatedAt, and endedAt.

hostUserId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator hosting the live stream.

visibility.description: Stream visibility matching the host account setting.

LiveChatMessage.title: LiveChatMessage
LiveChatMessage.description: Real-time viewer or host chat message inside an active live broadcast. Clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt.

streamHostId.description: Denormalized host UID from parent stream for secure subcollection queries.

streamVisibility.description: Denormalized visibility from parent stream for secure subcollection queries.

senderId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message sender.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated user account document containing profile details and PII (email, mobileNumber).

/users/{userId}/videos/{videoId}.description: Owner-isolated uploaded short video metadata documents created from the in-app camera or device gallery.

/users/{userId}/blocked_users/{blockedUs.description: Owner-isolated list of creators/users blocked by the account owner.

/live_streams/{streamId}.description: Active and ended live broadcast sessions. Public streams are discoverable by signed-in users; personal streams are restricted to the host.

/live_streams/{streamId}/chat/{messageId.description: Real-time chat messages posted inside a live stream room.
